items.title: Veeramani POCSO case: Key aide arrested, police trace money to railway union leader
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. In the ongoing POCSO probe against mining baron Veeramani of Gem Granites, the Chennai Crime Branch police have arrested his key aide, identified as Ganesan. Ganesan worked at Gem Granites for nearly 23 years, police said. According to the police press release, he had an explicit video on his mobile phone showing Veeramani with the minor girl and failed to inform the police about it. He was produced before the court and remanded to Puzhal Central Prison. Further investigation is underway to determine who sent the video of the minor girl to Ganesan and to understand the background behind why he kept it without informing the police. Meanwhile, the police have reportedly found financial transactions to several accounts of those who allegedly attempted to suppress the case. According to police sources, investigators have traced bank transactions to multiple accounts, including that of Prakash, a railway union leader’s son who is suspected to have helped Veeramani escape police action.
